title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a source-written exception can challenge a generic f9v gloss
summary: Search for a directly source-written exception or prohibition attached to an independently identified pansy-like entry, with an explicit comparison herb. Freeze its subject, condition and polarity before reading f9v. A whole reading that merely fits common medicinal prose should not count as matching a source-specific exception. No exception is asserted to exist and no target meaning is assigned.

design.unit: historical entry predicate with subject, condition and polarity
design.contrast: source-specific conditional relation versus generic medicinal paraphrase
design.prediction: if an eligible historical exception exists, a compatible whole reading preserves its conditional direction and owner
